title: Acceptance Limits for Length of Hire and for Named Drivers
content:
Wanderlane sells car hire under six Car Rental Rate Classes. Each class fixes for itself the shortest and
longest hire it may be sold for, the ages of main driver it accepts, the age below which a young driver
charge runs, and how many additional drivers it carries before a per-day charge begins. The schedule below
is the whole of those limits, class by class.

## Length of hire and age of the main driver

| Rate class | Shortest hire, in days | Longest hire, in days | Youngest main driver accepted, in whole years | Oldest main driver accepted, in whole years |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 2 | 21 | 21 | 75 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 1 | 28 | 21 | 75 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 1 | 30 | 21 | 79 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 1 | 30 | 21 | 79 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 1 | 30 | 25 | 79 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 1 | 60 | 21 | 79 |

## Driver charges the class carries

| Rate class | Age below which the young driver charge runs, in whole years | Young driver, per rental day, in USD | Main driver aged seventy or over, per rental day, in USD | Additional drivers carried free | Each further additional driver, per rental day, in USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 25 | 32 | 18 | 0 | 15 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 25 | 29 | 15 | 0 | 13.5 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 25 | 25 | 12 | 1 | 12 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 25 | 22 | 0 | 1 | 10 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 25 | 19 | 0 | 2 | 9 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 25 | 0 | 0 | 2 | 0 |

A figure of nothing against a driver charge means the class makes no charge under that head, not that the
head has been waived for a particular renter. The free additional driver count is a number of drivers, not
a number of days: it is the count carried on the agreement whatever the length of the hire.

## Reading the age columns

The youngest and oldest columns are the outer edges of what a class accepts; the young driver column is a
charge running inside those edges. On the Pay At Counter Flex Rate a main driver of 21 is inside the accepted
range and, being below 25, carries the young driver charge of 12 USD for every rental day. On the Premium
Inclusive Rate the same driver of 21 is below the youngest age the class accepts at all. On that class the
young driver age and the youngest accepted age are the same figure of 25, so no main driver sold that class
ever carries its young driver charge.
